# 盂蘭盆經疏鈔餘義

**ID:** X0376
**Volume:** X21
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 宋 日新錄
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0376

## Contributors
- 日新 (A000193)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X376 in one fascicle is a sub-sub-commentary on the *Yúlánpén* commentarial cluster — specifically, a "residual matters" (*yúyì* 餘義) gloss covering points either omitted or insufficiently treated in the existing *jì* 記 (sub-commentary) tradition on *[宗密's Shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365)*. Compiled by [日新](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%97%A5%E6%96%B0) of Pǔjìngsì 普靜寺 at Zháxī 霅谿 as auditor's notes (*suítīng cì lù* 隨聽次錄) on his teacher's lectures, dated **Xīníng 1 (1068 CE)**.

**Abstract**

The colophon and preface together give an unusually precise documentary record. [日新](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%97%A5%E6%96%B0)'s preface lists the prior sub-commentary tradition that the *Yúyì* engages: "普寧律師會粹記，明義大師隨難解…淨覺大師述名義，金山闍梨拾遺圖" — that is, the *Huìcuì jì* 會粹記 of Pǔníng *lǜshī* 普寧律師, the *Suínán jiě* 隨難解 of Míngyì *dàshī* 明義大師, the *Míngyì* 名義 of Jìngjué *dàshī* 淨覺大師 ([孤山智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93)'s honorific), and the *Shíyí tú* 拾遺圖 of Jīnshān *shélí* 金山闍梨 — establishing that by 1068 the *Yúlánpén* commentarial environment included at least four sub-commentaries beyond the better-known ones we today have. The dating colophon states: "時熙寧元年歲次戊申六月望日啟講，七月十有二日徹廗，因而再刊，又為之序云" — "in the *wùshēn* year, the first year of Xīníng (1068 CE), on the full-moon of the sixth month the lectures were inaugurated; on the twelfth of the seventh month they concluded; thereupon [the notes] were issued, and a preface was added." The work is therefore precisely datable to 1068.

The *Yúyì* contains lexicographic / phonological notes on contested terms in the parent commentaries, citations of canonical and lexicographic sources to adjudicate disputed readings, and supplementary doctrinal observations — e.g. on Zōngmì's syncretic statements about Confucian–Buddhist filiality. As a witness to the now-lost early-Sòng *Yúlánpén* sub-commentaries (the *Huìcuì*, the *Suínán*, the *Shíyí tú*), this work is essential for reconstructing the eleventh-century commentarial environment.

Parent texts (chain): [KR6i0364](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364) (T685) → [KR6i0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365) (T1792, Zōngmì) → various Sòng *jì* / *chāo* → this *Yúyì*.
